1.text: Gain 1 Influence on the planet of your choice.

2.text: Take the last card from any of your opponent’s columns, then add it to your column of the same color WITHOUT applying its effects.

3.text: Draw the top card of the deck and add it to your column of the same color WITHOUT applying its effects.

4.text: Discard the last card in your opponent’s corresponding column.

5.text: Take the Leader badge and place it on the Silver side. If you already have the Leader badge on the Silver side, flip it to the Gold side.

6.text: The gray color indicates that you can choose the color the effect applies to.

7.text: Gain the Gold Leader Badge OR 8 Credits

8.text: Gain 1 Influence on any planet whose disc is on your opponent’s side.

9.text: This icon is always paired with another icon and indicates that the entire effect refers to your opponent.

11.text: Take the indicated gain if you are in possession of an element.

12.text: Take 1 Zenithium if you have the Leader badge whether it is on the Silver or Gold side.

13.text: Take an element (card, Credit, Zenithium) from your opponent and place it on your side.

14.text: Take, if available, 1 Zenithium from your opponent's resources and add it to your own resources.

15.text: You MUST apply the left effect to gain the right effect. However, you may ignore the entire effect if you do not want to or cannot apply it.

16.text: Give your opponent, from your resources, the corresponding element to earn the indicated gain.

17.text: Give the Leader token to gain 2 Zenithium.

18.text: Immediately develop the indicated Technology with a discount of 1 Zenithium.

19.text: Immediately develop any Technology with a discount of 2 Zenithium.

20.text: Develop, without spending any Zenithium, your lowest Technology. If multiple Technologies are tied for lowest, choose only 1 of them.

21.text: Exile the 2/4/7 last cards from the corresponding column to gain 1/2/3 Influence respectively.

22.text: Gain 2 Credits per different card color in your columns (2/4/6/8/10 Credits for 1/2/3/4/5 card colors).

23.text: Gain 2 Credits per different card color in your opponent’s columns.

24.text: Gain 4/8/12 Credits if you have developed 1/2/3 Level 1 Technologies respectively.
